description: PropMon band-rating model (Ham Shack Automation). score = SFI x geomagnetic penalty, compared with each band's [fair, good] thresholds for its time of day. Shared with the Ham Ops Console's Field Mode engine; change it here, then bump model_version. v3 (2026-11-17): tuned against ten days of N4MI's SSB/FT8 sweeps, PSKReporter reports heard in EM83 and logged contacts — 10m/12m/15m thresholds lowered, 40m dawn stricter and day easier, softer storm penalties.

field_day.description: Field Day scale: North America reach (stations within 4,000 km of the station) on the non-WARC Field Day bands. Same score (SFI x geomagnetic penalty) and time-of-day rules as the DX scale; own thresholds. Tuned on Propagation Recorder data at EM83, 2026-11-07 to 11-17 (November, SFI 120-145): suited to Winter Field Day (late January); not validated for ARRL Field Day (June).

meanings.good: Wide North America coverage: phone contacts across much of the country likely.
meanings.fair: Some North America reach: workable but thinner or regional; easier on CW/digital.
meanings.poor: Little or no North America reach.

6m.note: Sporadic E openings can't be forecast from SFI/K - check the band
